signature: SUBROUTINE ZGESVD( JOBU, JOBVT, M, N, A, LDA, S, U, LDU, VT, LDVT,

params.name: jobu
jobvt
M
params.reference: The number of rows of the input matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the input matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.workDependent: on exit A is scratch, or (JOBU or JOBVT = 'O') singular vectors whose signs depend on the path LWORK selects

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: s
params.reference: The singular values of A, sorted so that $S(i) \ge S(i+1)$.

params.name: U
params.reference: (`LDU`,M) if `JOBU = 'A'` or (`LDU`,min(M,N)) if `JOBU = 'S'`. If `JOBU = 'A'`, U contains the M-by-M unitary matrix U; if `JOBU = 'S'`, U contains the first min(m,n) columns of U (the left singular vectors, stored columnwise); if `JOBU = 'N'` or 'O', U is not referenced.
params.workDependent: the left singular vectors' signs depend on the path LWORK selects

params.name: ldu
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array U. $\mathrm{LDU} \ge 1$; if `JOBU = 'S'` or 'A', $\mathrm{LDU} \ge M$.

params.name: VT
params.reference: If `JOBVT = 'A'`, `VT` contains the N-by-N unitary matrix $V^H$; if `JOBVT = 'S'`, `VT` contains the first min(m,n) rows of $V^H$ (the right singular vectors, stored rowwise); if `JOBVT = 'N'` or 'O', `VT` is not referenced.
params.workDependent: the right singular vectors' signs depend on the path LWORK selects

params.name: ldvt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VT`. $\mathrm{LDVT} \ge 1$; if `JOBVT = 'A'`, $\mathrm{LDVT} \ge N$; if `JOBVT = 'S'`, $\mathrm{LDVT} \ge \min (M,N)$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,2 \, \min (M,N)+\max (M,N))$. For good performance, `LWORK` should generally be larger.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: RWORK
params.reference: On exit, if $\mathrm{INFO} > 0$, `RWORK(1:MIN(M,N)-1)` contains the unconverged superdiagonal elements of an upper bidiagonal matrix B whose diagonal is in S (not necessarily sorted). B satisfies $A = U \, B \, \mathrm{VT}$, so it has the same singular values as A, and singular vectors related by U and `VT`.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `> 0`: if ZBDSQR did not converge, `INFO` specifies how many superdiagonals of an intermediate bidiagonal form B did not converge to zero. See the description of `RWORK` above for details.

checks.fortran: .NOT.( WNTVA .OR. WNTVS .OR. WNTVO .OR. WNTVN ) .OR. ( WNTVO .AND. WNTUO )

checks.js: (ldvt < 1 || (jobvt === 'all-rows' && ldvt < N)) || (jobvt === 'economy' && ldvt < min( M, N ))

untranslated: WORK.minLength: local MINWRK is assigned inside nested control flow

overrides.reason: ZGESVD picks its path from LWORK: for M much larger than N (or N much larger than M) it uses a work matrix for the fast QR (LQ) variant only when LWORK holds it, and otherwise applies the QR (LQ) factor through ZUNMBR; the callees' block sizes follow LWORK too. Singular vectors are determined only up to sign (a unit phase for complex), so a different path can return different ones; A is scratch unless JOBU or JOBVT is 'O', and then holds vectors of that sign. S does not depend on LWORK; the module's tests check every path, at the minimum WORK and between it and the optimum, against the optimum by property (orthonormal U and V^H, A = U*S*V^H, vectors equal up to sign) (ticket 0100).

set.params.A.workDependent: on exit A is scratch, or (JOBU or JOBVT = 'O') singular vectors whose signs depend on the path LWORK selects
set.params.U.workDependent: the left singular vectors' signs depend on the path LWORK selects
set.params.VT.workDependent: the right singular vectors' signs depend on the path LWORK selects
